questions.objective: Assess sleep latency, awakenings, and feeling refreshed
questions.patient_text: How is your current sleep pattern at night? (Nidra)

options.label: Good — Fall asleep within 15-20 minutes, sleep continuously, wake refreshed
Difficulty falling asleep / mind racing / light restless sleep
Waking up in the middle of night feeling hot or sweating
Excessive sleepiness, sleeping >9 hours, still feeling heavy/groggy
